Anya (PM): Quick sync  we need final decisions on packaging + upgrade UX for private deploys. Focus areas: delta patches, CNI choices (BYO vs opinionated), and customer IPAM integration. Can we lock an MVP by EOD tomorrow?
Marcos (Packaging Eng): Proposed delta approach: ship full manifest + optional binary diff layers. Agent applies diffs if present, falls back to full image. Signed manifests only.
Marcos (Packaging Eng): Example manifest header (concept):
```
{
  "version": "v1",
  "release": "2026-03-21-rc1",
  "components": [
    {"name":"runtime","sha256":"abc123...","delta_to":"runtime@v1.2.3.delta"},
    {"name":"agent","sha256":"def456..."}
  ],
  "signature":"ksm:base64sig"
}
```
Priya (Network Eng): Important: many customers want BYO-CNI (calico/cilium/flannel). We should expose hook points for installing CNI manifests rather than bundling a single CNI. That reduces ops friction. Also need to validate network policy api versions.
Liu (SRE): Upgrade orchestration notes: preflight checks -> staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) -> postflight health probe window. If probe fails, automatic rollback. Need idempotent upgrade steps when agent is restarted mid-upgrade.
Liu (SRE): Sample rollout config snippet:
```
rollout:
  canaries: [0.1, 0.5, 1.0]
  health_probe: /healthz?timeout=30s
  rollback_on: [pod_crashloop, high_error_rate]
```
Sofia (Customer Success): Field asks: per-tenant IP ranges, deterministic node hostnames for DNS records, and a migration story for customers with existing IPAM. They'll want sample terraform for IP allocation and a one-page ops checklist.
Marcos (Packaging Eng): On-airgap: customers expect an offline bundle that includes ALL deltas + full blobs. We'll validate bundle size and provide a `bundle verify` command to check checksums/signatures before install.
Priya (Network Eng): Also: expose MTU settings and provide small/large MTU smoke tests. Some customers use jumbo frames and need example iptables/nft rules to avoid PMTU blackholes.
Anya (PM): Tradeoffs: BYO-CNI = less support overhead but more customer setup variability. Opinionated CNI = easier support but more customer pushback. Proposal: MVP = BYO-CNI with optional recommended CNI bundle for customers who want it.
Marcos (Packaging Eng): Dev task list: delta format spec, bundle tooling (`bundle create|verify|extract`), agent delta apply logic, offline bundle smoke tests. Est 2 weeks for core + 1 week for extra CNI bundle.
Liu (SRE): Observability: emit upgrade events to telemetry: upgrade_id, component, step, duration, success_bool. Add a minimal schema so support can triage failed upgrades quickly.
Sofia (Customer Success): I'll collect example terraform + IPAM mappings from 2 customers and assemble the one-pager. Also coordinate a field beta for BYO-CNI installs.
ci-bot: [build] private-deploy/bundle-tooling #603 passed  artifacts at registry.redwood.internal/bundles/603.tar.gz
Anya (PM): Decisions for MVP (agreed):
- Support BYO-CNI via installation hooks + recommend bundle option
- Delta manifest format with sha256 + signature; agent falls back to full blob
- Offline bundle includes verify tool and full blobs for airgap installs
- Upgrade orchestration with staged canary (10/50/100) + auto-rollback on health probes
- Telemetry schema for upgrade events and bundle verification logs
Action items (owners):
- Marcos -> delta spec + bundle tooling PR (JIRA PACK-218)
- Priya -> CNI hook API + MTU smoke tests
- Liu -> rollout orchestration robustness + telemetry schema
- Sofia -> field beta recruitment + docs one-pager
Anya (PM): Deadline: have PRs + docs drafts by EOD Thursday so we can freeze for dev sprint. Any blockers?
Priya (Network Eng): Need clarity on supported iptables vs nft default. I'll send a compatibility matrix tomorrow.
Marcos (Packaging Eng): Will prototype `bundle verify` by tomorrow AM.
Liu (SRE): I'll add the idempotency tests to the nightly pipeline.
Sofia (Customer Success): I'll get the two customer examples by EOD Wed.
Anya (PM): Great. We'll reconvene Fri morning if needed. Thanks. :thumbsup:
